A [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''receptionist''' was on duty in the waiting area of the infirmary ward aboard the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], during the [[Starship/Legends|vessel's]] murder investigation into the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] [[Tanith Sorn]].
